description.value:
Your eyes are replaced with those of a nihili, decompressing your enemies with your gaze and preventing them from filling their lungs.

Activate—Decompressing Stare 2 (concentrate, occult, visual)

Frequency once per hour

Effect Your eyes glaze over with the hollow void of space, forcing a creature you can see within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued] until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is fatigued for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] until the start of your next turn.
